test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a rectangular table (not necessarily in the same order) facing towards the centre. 4 persons are sitting at each corner, and one person is sitting at the middle of each shorter side of the table. B is an immediate neighbour of D and C. F is an immediate neighbour of A and D. E is an immediate neighbour of A and C. F is not sitting at any of the corners.

Which of the following pairs represents the persons who are sitting exactly opposite to each other?
solution:
Given: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a rectangular table facing towards the centre.

1) F is an immediate neighbour of A and D.

2) F is not sitting at any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8235cea0a83b20aa2f8a717965b473c72aa86380c1b0c569442e267593914a0e.png] 

3) B is an immediate neighbour of D and C.

4) E is an immediate neighbour of A and C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74c247045b6986c950fbf37576ca61c45683bb0f90fee2b87493dd885fb7a966.png] 

Here, the pairs 'FC' represents the persons that are sitting exactly opposite to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
